correctness.rationale: The repaired proof establishes the original statement without assuming that outside forces can be ignored. The frozen Step 3 licenses forces entirely within a prefix, but its chronology argument does not justify omitting a force with source outside and target inside. The replacement verifies all 84 left-window seeds: the listed 13 fill the first three columns before column 3 is touched; the other 71 reach a closed configuration without ever coloring column 4. Every source in these histories has unchanged neighbors in every grid of length at least five. A closed blue set containing the seed traps every forcing order. Independently, two blue vertices can at best produce one corner L and stall. Three blue vertices forcing from an interior outer-row degree-three source away from the ends produce the same four-vertex T for each choice of blue-neighbor pair, which stalls. A corner with its neighbor makes a three-vertex L that cannot interact with a third vertex beyond the left three columns. The full seed classification and the nonadjacency of the end families follow. Independent recomputation by Floyd–Warshall recovered the listed 24 edges, radius 3 and diameter 5 of each component and the stated width-three and width-four exceptions.
residual_risks: The 84-case certificate is finite and is used only in conjunction with the width-transfer proof. No independent Lean or expert attestation is asserted.

originality.rationale: The exact minimum-set census and disconnection threshold for ordinary zero forcing on three-row open rectangular grids are distinguished from the already-known minimum cardinality and from general zero-forcing reconfiguration examples. The repair also corrects the attribution of the known cardinality formula. No equivalent coverage of the supported classification was found in the comparisons below.
residual_risks: The complete 2008 article was not recovered and unindexed equivalent grid classifications may exist. One additional literature query was deferred; it is not a negative result. This is a best-knowledge comparison, not a priority certificate.

value.rationale: Determining the optima rather than merely their size settles when an optimal initial placement can be moved from one end to the other by exchanges that never increase the number of blue seeds. The sharp stable two-component regime and complete small graph are structural information about a natural infinite family.
residual_risks: No conclusion for wider strips or reconfiguration with extra tokens.
